bitcoin_etfs_allowed.basis: Team statement that DECA SMG permits spot bitcoin ETFs such as IBIT.
bitcoin_etfs_allowed.conflicts_with: docs/rules/deca-verified.md: the published DECA SMG guidelines list futures, options, commodities, currencies and bitcoin as banned, and the 2026-09-06 review concluded IBIT should not be bought until SIFMA confirms in writing.
bitcoin_etfs_allowed.to_verify: Advisor emails decasmg@sifma.org, or the team copies the relevant text from the in-portfolio Local Rules page. Paste the confirmation or its location into written_source to mark this ruling verified.
bitcoin_etfs_allowed.scope: Spot bitcoin ETFs listed on NYSE or NASDAQ only. Commodity trusts (GLD, SLV), direct crypto, futures, options and currencies stay prohibited.
